visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a striped sweater (black, white, and red), holds a large display box containing several smaller black blind boxes. Each small box features her portrait and the text 'Happy Birthday'. The setting is a brightly lit indoor living room with a gray sofa. (2) She picks up a single box, turning it to reveal a calendar for March 2025 printed on the back. Her facial expression is cheerful as she speaks directly to the camera. (3) She opens the box and pulls out two small, red, diamond-shaped cards featuring a cartoon dog. (4) She continues the unboxing, showing three Polaroid-style photographs: one of herself in swimwear, one of a dog, and another portrait of herself. She holds them up close to the lens. (5) She opens another compartment and retrieves two round white badges with dog illustrations. (6) A medium-sized, light-brown dog (Cocker Spaniel) appears beside her on the sofa. She playfully attaches a badge to the dog's fur while smiling. (7) She holds the entire display set once more, gesturing with her hands as she finishes her presentation, looking satisfied and happy.
